description: The ETFs summary endpoint provides a concise overview of global Exchange-Traded Funds. It returns key data points such as ETF names, symbols, and current market values, enabling users to quickly assess the performance and status of various international ETFs. This summary is ideal for users who need a snapshot of the global ETF landscape without delving into detailed analysis.
